notes: MANUAL CONTROL - Gemini analyzes but does NOT auto-tune. Adjust factors below as needed.

factor_descriptions.min_edge_percent: Minimum edge required to trade (0.01 = 1%). Lower = more aggressive.
factor_descriptions.critical_distance_dollars: Skip if BTC within this $ of strike. Higher = more conservative.
factor_descriptions.safe_distance_dollars: Confident trade if BTC beyond this $ from strike.
factor_descriptions.strong_market_consensus: If yes_bid > this, market strongly expects YES.
factor_descriptions.weak_market_consensus: If yes_bid < this, market strongly expects NO.
factor_descriptions.expiry_critical_minutes: Skip if < this many minutes to expiry.
factor_descriptions.expiry_urgent_minutes: Reduce confidence if < this many minutes to expiry.
